Partner with ROeS 2027 and connect with leading statisticians, data scientists and healthcare researchers from the Austro-Swiss region and beyond. The 35<sup>th</sup> ROeS Conference, *Augmenting Statistics: Better and Faster Data-Driven Decisions*, takes place from 16<sup>th</sup> to 19<sup>th</sup> August 2027 at the University of Bern, Switzerland.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
<i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf"></i> **Full details:** [Download the ROeS 2027 sponsorship prospectus (PDF)](data/ROeS%202027%20sponsorship%20BR_Oct_25nd_Final.pdf){target="_blank"}
:::

## Why support ROeS 2027?

```{=html}
<div class="sponsor-why">
  <div class="sponsor-why__item">
    <i class="bi bi-people"></i>
    <h3>~200 on-site participants</h3>
    <p>Biostatisticians, data scientists, clinical trialists, epidemiologists, PhD students and early-career researchers from Switzerland, Austria, Europe and beyond.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="sponsor-why__item">
    <i class="bi bi-bullseye"></i>
    <h3>Targeted visibility</h3>
    <p>Showcase your methodological leadership and data-driven solutions in an intimate setting.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="sponsor-why__item">
    <i class="bi bi-arrow-left-right"></i>
    <h3>Academic-industry synergy</h3>
    <p>Engage directly with key quantitative researchers and decision-makers.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="sponsor-why__item">
    <i class="bi bi-mortarboard"></i>
    <h3>Empower early-career talent</h3>
    <p>Contributions fund travel grants and keep registration fees accessible for PhD students.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="sponsor-tiers">
  <div class="sponsor-tier sponsor-tier--silver">

    <ul>
      <li>Logo on website, screens and program book</li>
    </ul>

    <h3>Gold Partner</h3>

  </div>
  <div class="sponsor-tier sponsor-tier--platinum">
```
